file.title: File
file.description: A single JPEG, PNG or WebP.

device_uid.title: Device Uid
device_uid.description: Generated once by the client on first launch and never again. Not a vendor id: those change on reinstall.

DeviceInput.title: DeviceInput
DeviceInput.description: The handset behind a login. Sent on every authentication.

DeviceUpdateInput.title: DeviceUpdateInput
DeviceUpdateInput.description: What a client may change about itself after login.

gst_state.title: Gst State
gst_state.description: `present`, `skipped` or `missing`. Three states and not a boolean, because a skip is not final.

company.title: Company
company.description: The company the GSTIN resolved to.

occurred_at.title: Occurred At
occurred_at.description: When the tap happened, ISO-8601 **with** an explicit offset or Z, stamped from the server-corrected clock. Omit it and the server uses its own time. More than 60s ahead is CLOCK_SKEW; more than 72h old is STALE_INTENT.

clock_offset_ms.title: Clock Offset Ms
clock_offset_ms.description: The correction the client applied, recorded for support.

upload_ids.title: Upload Ids
upload_ids.description: The jangad's pages, staged with POST /uploads, in page order.

pickup_address_id.title: Pickup Address Id
pickup_address_id.description: One of the ids from GET /addresses.

manual_pickup_address.title: Manual Pickup Address
manual_pickup_address.description: A new address, typed. Give this or pickup_address_id, not both and not neither.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: The receipt number the office sees.

submitted_at.title: Submitted At
submitted_at.description: When the customer captured it, not when it reached the server — the two differ whenever it was submitted offline.

gst_state.title: Gst State
gst_state.description: Customers only: `present`, `skipped` or `missing`. A skipped customer may be asked again on a later launch, so do not treat a missing GSTIN as a blocker (decision D3).

sent.title: Sent
sent.description: Always true on a 200. The answer is identical for a known and an unknown number: which numbers have accounts is not something this endpoint will tell you.

resend_after.title: Resend After
resend_after.description: Seconds before another code may be requested. Drive the resend countdown from this.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Always `whatsapp`. Say so in the UI, or every support call will be about a missing SMS.

registration_required.title: Registration Required
registration_required.description: True when the number has no account yet. Tokens are then null and `registration_token` must be sent to /auth/register.

registration_token.title: Registration Token
registration_token.description: From /auth/otp/verify. Proof the number answered a code.

vat.title: Vat
vat.description: A GSTIN. Optional: a customer may complete registration without one and be asked again later.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: A hint so the client can draw its navigation before the first call. Never a gate: every route checks the group server-side.

reference.title: Reference
reference.description: Quote this in the intent's upload_ids.

sha256.title: Sha256
sha256.description: Of the bytes as sent. Verify it, then delete the local copy only once the *intent* is acknowledged.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: An upload nothing claims is collected after this.

SudiJWT.description: Access token returned by the login endpoint.
